_metadata.source: Near East University – neu.edu.tr, neareasthospital.com, official campus data
_metadata.purpose: Location and navigation data for NEU campus in Nicosia, North Cyprus (Lefkoşa, KKTC)

campus_overview.name: Near East University Main Campus
campus_overview.address: Near East Boulevard (Yakın Doğu Bulvarı), Nicosia (Lefkoşa), TRNC

how_to_reach.by_shuttle: Free NEU shuttle buses run from 06:45 to 22:15 between campus and Nicosia city centre, Kyrenia, Famagusta, and Güzelyurt. Schedule: https://bus.neu.edu.tr/
how_to_reach.by_public_bus: Frequent public buses between campus and Nicosia city centre via Gönyeli.
how_to_reach.by_car: Follow Near East Boulevard (Yakın Doğu Bulvarı) from the Nicosia ring road. The main campus gate is clearly signposted.
how_to_reach.from_airport: Ercan Airport is approximately 20–25 minutes by car. NEU shuttle also serves airport route on request.

academic_buildings.name: Faculty of Engineering
academic_buildings.directions: Enter the main campus gate on Near East Boulevard. The Faculty of Engineering building is in the central-north part of campus. Follow the main road and look for the engineering signboards.

academic_buildings.name: Faculty of Medicine
academic_buildings.location_description: Main Campus, adjacent to NEU Hospital
academic_buildings.directions: The Faculty of Medicine is located directly beside the NEU Hospital building. Follow signs to the hospital from the main gate; the Faculty of Medicine entrance is adjacent.

academic_buildings.name: Faculty of Dentistry / NEU Dental Hospital
academic_buildings.location_description: Separate dedicated building on NEU campus
academic_buildings.directions: The Dental Hospital is a separate building on the NEU campus, near the Faculty of Medicine. Follow signs for 'Dental Hospital' or 'Diş Hastanesi' from the main campus road.

academic_buildings.name: Faculty of Architecture
academic_buildings.directions: Located in the main campus area near the Faculty of Engineering. Follow campus signboards for 'Architecture' or 'Mimarlık'.

academic_buildings.name: Faculty of Law
academic_buildings.near: Psychological Counselling Centre (located in same building)
academic_buildings.note: The Psychological Counselling and Research Centre (free counselling for students) is located in the Faculty of Law building.
academic_buildings.directions: Follow campus signboards for 'Faculty of Law' or 'Hukuk Fakültesi'.

academic_buildings.name: Faculty of Economics and Administrative Sciences
academic_buildings.near: Post Office (Ground Floor of this building)
academic_buildings.note: The NEU Post Office is located on the Ground Floor of this faculty building.
academic_buildings.directions: Follow campus signboards for 'Economics' or 'İİBF'. The post office is on the ground floor.

academic_buildings.name: Faculty of Pharmacy
academic_buildings.directions: Follow campus signboards for 'Pharmacy' or 'Eczacılık'.

academic_buildings.name: Faculty of Nursing
academic_buildings.location_description: Main Campus, near Faculty of Medicine
academic_buildings.directions: Near the Faculty of Medicine and NEU Hospital. Follow signs for 'Nursing' or 'Hemşirelik'.

academic_buildings.name: Faculty of Arts and Sciences
academic_buildings.directions: Follow campus signboards for 'Arts and Sciences' or 'Fen-Edebiyat'.

academic_buildings.name: Faculty of Communication
academic_buildings.directions: Follow campus signboards for 'Communication' or 'İletişim'. Near East TV and Radio are also in this area.

academic_buildings.name: Faculty of Fine Arts and Design
academic_buildings.directions: Follow signs for 'Fine Arts' or 'Güzel Sanatlar'.

academic_buildings.name: Faculty of Tourism
academic_buildings.directions: Follow campus signboards for 'Tourism' or 'Turizm'.

academic_buildings.name: Faculty of Civil and Environmental Engineering
academic_buildings.directions: Follow signs for 'Civil Engineering' or 'İnşaat'. Near the main engineering cluster.

academic_buildings.name: Faculty of Artificial Intelligence and Informatics
academic_buildings.directions: Follow signs for 'AI and Informatics' or 'Yapay Zeka'. Near the engineering faculties.

academic_buildings.name: Atatürk Faculty of Education
academic_buildings.directions: Follow signs for 'Education Faculty' or 'Eğitim Fakültesi'.

academic_buildings.name: Faculty of Health Sciences
academic_buildings.location_description: Main Campus, health cluster near hospital
academic_buildings.directions: Located near the NEU Hospital. Follow signs for 'Health Sciences' or 'Sağlık Bilimleri'.

academic_buildings.name: Faculty of Veterinary Medicine / Near East Animal Hospital
academic_buildings.directions: Follow signs for 'Veterinary' or 'Veterinerlik'. The animal hospital is attached to the faculty building.

academic_buildings.name: Faculty of Sports Sciences
academic_buildings.directions: Located near the Olympic Swimming Pool and Sports Tower. Follow signs for 'Sports Sciences' or 'Spor Bilimleri'.

academic_buildings.name: Faculty of Agriculture
academic_buildings.directions: Follow campus signboards for 'Agriculture' or 'Ziraat'.

academic_buildings.name: Faculty of Theology
academic_buildings.directions: Follow campus signboards for 'Theology' or 'İlahiyat'.

key_locations.name: Grand Library (Near East University Grand Library)
key_locations.location_description: Separate large building, central area of main campus
key_locations.directions: The Grand Library is a large standalone building in the heart of the campus. It is one of the most prominent buildings on campus and is signposted from all main campus roads. Open 24 hours.

key_locations.name: NEU Hospital (Near East Hospital)
key_locations.location_description: Separate large hospital building on NEU campus
key_locations.floors: Ground (0) to 9th floor (West Block); Ground to 4th floor (East Block)
key_locations.directions: The NEU Hospital is a large, clearly marked building on the NEU campus. Follow signs for 'NEU Hospital' or 'Yakın Doğu Hastanesi' from the main campus gate. The hospital has its own dedicated entrance.
key_locations.note: See neu_hospital_departments.json for exact floor and block of all 55 departments.

key_locations.name: Atatürk Culture and Congress Centre (AKKM)
key_locations.directions: The AKKM is a large standalone congress/theatre building on campus. It is the biggest congress hall in North Nicosia. Follow signs for 'AKKM' or 'Congress Centre'. Cafe AKKM is located inside.

key_locations.name: Olympic Indoor Swimming Pool
key_locations.location_description: Separate swimming pool building, sports area of campus
key_locations.directions: Located in the sports zone of the campus near the Sports Tower and Sports Sciences Faculty. The only Olympic indoor swimming pool in Northern Cyprus. Follow signs for 'Swimming Pool' or 'Yüzme Havuzu'.

key_locations.name: Sports Tower
key_locations.directions: Located in the sports zone near the Olympic Swimming Pool and Sports Sciences Faculty. Follow signs for 'Sports Tower' or 'Spor Kulesi'.

key_locations.name: Student Dormitories
key_locations.directions: The dormitory complex is located on the main campus. There are 7 female dormitory blocks and 6 male dormitory blocks. The Dormitory Registration Office is inside the AKKM building. A supermarket is located below Dormitory 1.

key_locations.name: Post Office
key_locations.location_description: Ground Floor, Faculty of Economics and Administrative Sciences building
key_locations.directions: The NEU Post Office is on the ground floor of the Faculty of Economics and Administrative Sciences (İktisadi ve İdari Bilimler Fakültesi) building. Follow signs for 'IIBF' or the Economics Faculty, then look for Post Office signs on the ground floor.

key_locations.name: Supermarket
key_locations.directions: The campus supermarket is located below (underneath) Dormitory 1 in the dormitory complex. Follow signs for 'Dormitory 1' or 'Yurt 1'; the supermarket entrance is at ground/basement level.

key_locations.name: Near East Bank (Campus Branch)
key_locations.directions: Near East Bank has a full branch on the main campus. Follow campus signboards for 'Near East Bank'. Full banking services available.

key_locations.name: Türkiye İş Bankası (Campus Branch)
key_locations.directions: A full branch of Türkiye İş Bankası is located on the main campus. Follow campus signboards.

key_locations.name: Ziraat Bankası ATM
key_locations.directions: A Ziraat Bankası ATM is available on the main campus. ATM only, no full branch.

key_locations.name: Fuel Station (Near East Fuel Station)
key_locations.directions: The fuel station is on the campus perimeter road. Visible from Near East Boulevard.

key_locations.name: NEU Lake
key_locations.location_description: Outdoor recreational area on campus grounds
key_locations.directions: An outdoor lake on the campus grounds, used as a recreational and relaxation area by students.

key_locations.name: Park Near East
key_locations.directions: A 220,000 m² park on the campus grounds, used for large concerts and events (Deep Purple, Moscow State Ballet, Spring Fest, Rock 'n Cyprus Festival). Follow signs for 'Park Near East'.

key_locations.name: Museum of Classical and Sports Cars (Cyprus Car Museum)
key_locations.directions: A separate museum building on the NEU campus. Follow signs for 'Car Museum' or 'Araba Müzesi'. Over 140 vehicles on display. Mobile app available.

key_locations.name: GÜNSEL Art Museum (Cyprus Modern Art Museum)
key_locations.directions: Follow signs for 'GÜNSEL Art Museum' or 'Sanat Müzesi'.

key_locations.name: Communications Museum
key_locations.directions: Follow campus signs for 'Communications Museum' or 'İletişim Müzesi'.

key_locations.name: Dorana Residence (Hotel on Campus)
key_locations.amenities: Central heating/cooling, LED TV, mini bar, shower, hair dryer, free internet
key_locations.directions: A small hotel/residence within the NEU campus, used by visiting guests and academics. Follow signs for 'Dorana Residence'.

key_locations.name: Near East TV
key_locations.directions: Located in the campus media/communication area. Follow signs for 'Near East TV'.

key_locations.name: Near East FM Radio
key_locations.directions: Located in the campus media area, near Near East TV. Follow signs for 'Near East FM'.

key_locations.name: Psychological Counselling and Research Centre
key_locations.note: Free counselling services available to all NEU students.
key_locations.directions: Located inside the Faculty of Law building. Free psychological counselling for all NEU students. Ask at the Faculty of Law reception.

key_locations.name: International Students Office (ISO)
key_locations.directions: Located in the main campus administrative buildings. Contact via WhatsApp or the main switchboard for exact location.

key_locations.name: Student Deanship
key_locations.directions: Located in the main campus administrative area. Follow signs for 'Student Deanship' or 'Öğrenci Dekanlığı'.

key_locations.name: RA 25 Sports Hall
key_locations.note: Named after NEU's first solar-powered car. Multi-purpose indoor sports hall.
key_locations.directions: Located in the sports area of campus near the Olympic Swimming Pool. Follow signs for 'RA 25 Sports Hall'.

key_locations.name: Health and Wellness Centre
key_locations.directions: Follow campus signs for 'Health and Wellness Centre' or 'Sağlık Merkezi'.

key_locations.name: Book House (Campus Bookstore)
key_locations.directions: The campus bookstore selling course books is located inside the Grand Library building. Enter the Grand Library and follow signs for 'Book House' or 'Kitap Evi'.

key_locations.name: Cyprus Herbarium and Natural History Museum
key_locations.name_tr: Kıbrıs Herbaryumu ve Doğa Tarihi Müzesi
key_locations.directions: Follow campus signs for 'Herbarium'. Part of the university's research infrastructure.

hospital_quick_navigation.note: NEU Hospital has two blocks (East and West) with floors Ground (0) to 9th (West) and Ground to 4th (East). Full department list with exact floors in neu_hospital_departments.json.

emergency.note: Go directly to Emergency on 1st Floor West Block for any emergency.

separate_dental_building: Oral and Dental Health — NEU Dental Hospital (separate building on campus)

general_navigation_tips.tip1: NEU does not publicly publish individual room numbers for administrative offices. Call the main switchboard or use the phone directory at https://neu.edu.tr/phone-directory/?lang=en to find specific rooms.
general_navigation_tips.tip2: Campus signboards in both Turkish and English are present at all major intersections on campus.
general_navigation_tips.tip3: The campus security office (extension 5308) can help with directions 24/7.
general_navigation_tips.tip4: Shuttle buses run from 06:45–22:15 and stop at major campus locations. Full schedule at https://bus.neu.edu.tr/
